title: Ranveer Singh's ₹1,800 Crore Monster Is Finally Coming to India — But NRIs Already Watched It a Month Ago
excerpt: Dhurandhar: The Revenge hits JioHotstar on June 4 with an uncut 'Raw & Undekha' version that restores every frame the CBFC trimmed, while NRIs abroad have been streaming it on Netflix since May 15
body:
Ranveer Singh's spy thriller *Dhurandhar: The Revenge* — the highest-grossing Hindi film of all time at over ₹1,800 crore worldwide — will finally arrive on JioHotstar on June 4, 2026, with full streaming access beginning June 5. The India OTT debut comes nearly three months after the film's theatrical release on March 19, and a full month after it landed on Netflix for international audiences on May 15.

## The Gap That Frustrated Indian Fans

The staggered release has been a source of quiet irritation for Indian subscribers who watched their NRI friends, family, and Instagram mutuals post about watching *Dhurandhar 2* on Netflix weeks ago. International viewers across the US, UK, Canada, and the Gulf got to stream the film from May 15 — while Indian audiences had to wait or head back to theatres, where the film was still running in reduced shows.

This is not an unusual pattern — global streaming rights increasingly favour international windows before Indian OTT premieres — but the scale of the gap is new. For a film that earned ₹1,150 crore in India alone, the month-long wait felt pointed.

## Raw & Undekha: The Version India Never Saw

The JioHotstar release is not just a standard digital premiere. The platform will stream the "Raw & Undekha" version of the film — an extended, uncut edition that restores graphic combat sequences, gore-heavy action, and explicit content that the Central Board of Film Certification trimmed for the theatrical release.

Director Aditya Dhar has spoken openly about the cuts, suggesting that the CBFC-approved version, while commercially dominant, was not the film he originally envisioned. The Raw & Undekha cut is reportedly three minutes longer than the theatrical version, with restored sequences in the Karachi infiltration act and the film's climactic confrontation between Ranveer Singh's undercover agent and Arjun Rampal's antagonist.

For audiences who saw it in cinemas, this is a reason to revisit. For everyone else, it's the definitive version.

## Pre-Show and Premiere Event

JioHotstar is treating the release as a tentpole event. The platform has announced a 30-minute pre-show on June 4 at 7 PM IST featuring behind-the-scenes content, cast interviews with Ranveer Singh, Arjun Rampal, Sanjay Dutt, and Sara Arjun, and candid production insights. Full streaming access begins the following day.

The premiere will be accessible to JioHotstar's 300 million-plus subscriber base, making it one of the largest same-day streaming audiences for any Indian film.

## The Box Office Context

To appreciate what's arriving on JioHotstar, consider the numbers. *Dhurandhar: The Revenge* grossed ₹1,800 crore worldwide in its theatrical run — ₹1,150 crore from India and over ₹650 crore from overseas markets. The original *Dhurandhar* (December 2025) earned ₹1,355 crore globally. Together, the franchise has crossed ₹3,150 crore worldwide in under six months — a figure that would have been dismissed as fantasy for Hindi cinema even two years ago.

In North America alone, the sequel shattered Part 1's opening day records with over $330K in advance sales across 472 locations. Telugu diaspora audiences drove significant overseas numbers alongside the traditional Hindi-belt NRI markets.

## What NRIs Already Know

Diaspora audiences have had the film for a month. The Netflix international release on May 15 was itself a cultural event in NRI households — group watch parties in living rooms from New Jersey to Fremantle, Instagram stories tagging friends with "finally," and family WhatsApp groups sharing timestamps of favourite scenes.

If you're an NRI who's already seen it, the Raw & Undekha version on JioHotstar is worth a second viewing for the restored sequences alone. If you haven't — June 5 is the date.

## Where to Watch

**International (US, UK, Canada, Gulf, Australia):** Already streaming on **Netflix** since May 15, 2026.

**India:** Premieres on **JioHotstar** on **June 4** (pre-show at 7 PM IST), full streaming from **June 5**. Raw & Undekha uncut version.
